economic_hypothesis: A relatively steep domestic sovereign yield curve can accompany weak current conditions or accommodative short rates and a higher subsequent equity risk premium. Test a steep-curve state against later mainland broad-ETF returns. Expected growth, inflation, policy and term-premium changes can invalidate this sign; this is an original falsifiable proxy, not a replication or a claim of profitable predictability.
distinct_from_previous_work: Same-currency government10yminus1yYTM, not SHIBORbank funding spread, LPRminusSHIBOR, corporate credit spread, oil price or ETF price/volume. Old state-conditioned stock signals and prior exact studies remain consumed. Shared macro risk and reusedETFoutcomes prevent a claim of statistical independence.

source.provider: CCDC public CGB Yield Curve and Others history form
source.measure: fitted yield to maturity, percent per annum; not spot rates, forward rates or executable quotes
source.month_end_selection: Last available row dated in that calendar month, no more than7calendar days before month end. Both1yand10y must be present on that same row. Unknown otherwise; no cross-date tenor joins, interpolation or carry across missing months.
source.timing_assumption: The currently reconstructed monthly-end curve values are assumed available by the end of that calendar month for conditional historical falsification only. Current publisher statement says business-day17:30Beijing publication. Historical values, precise release clocks and revision chain remain unverified; no certified point-in-time claim.
source.execution_clock: First mainlandETFexchange-session open strictly after the calendar quarter end; never the curve observation day's open. A later source-readiness failure stops or records unknown under the frozen rule, never backdates source publication.

signal.condition: Current quarter-end month's slope strictly exceeds the median of the preceding12consecutive calendar-month slopes, excluding the current month. Even-sample median is the mean of the middle two values. Equality selects cash.
signal.missing_input: Any missing current month or any of the12preceding months produces unknown/cash. Retain that quarter in all denominators and unconditional comparator.

proposed_fixed_diagnostic.intervals: First exchange open after each quarter end to the next corresponding open; first decision follows2012Q4, last follows2023Q3, terminal is first2024exchange open.44planned nonoverlapping quarters; missing-source quarters remain cash/unknown.
proposed_fixed_diagnostic.return: RawETFopen-to-open return plus declared cash distributions for entitlement acquired at or before record date and disposed after it; no dividend reinvestment. Exact price/calendar/action pins and event conventions must be frozen before any actual financial computation.
proposed_fixed_diagnostic.primary_effect: D=sum((z-zbar)*log1p(interval_gross_return))/sum(interval_sessions); zbar=sum(z*interval_sessions)/sum(interval_sessions); z=1selected,0knowncashorunknown. This is duration-matched conditional gross timing contribution, not net account PnL.
proposed_fixed_diagnostic.uncertainty: 5000paired circular block resamples of4consecutive quarterly intervals; recompute zbar and D per draw; seed20260922; linear2.5/97.5percentiles. No other block lengths or horizons selected after viewing results.
proposed_fixed_diagnostic.episode: A maximal run of selected adjacent quarters, not one independent trade per quarter. Report partial carry-in episodes for later slice.
proposed_fixed_diagnostic.counting: Gross positive-quarter frequency is descriptive and not completed-trade net win rate. The future account must preserve continuous holdings across unchanged signals and apply lot sizes, fees, liquidity and risk limits.
proposed_fixed_diagnostic.outcome_exposure: Overlapping2013..2023ETFhistory is already exposed through prior studies. The later chronological slice is a stability check, not an untouched out-of-sample claim. Local2026ETFholdout remains sealed.
proposed_fixed_diagnostic.stop_rule: At most one new economic diagnostic may be admitted later. A necessary-screen failure closes this exact hypothesis without sign, tenor, median-window, horizon, period, source-vintage or risk-policy rescue. A pass only permits separate frozen net-account review, never direct promotion.
